notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43435713/529bd56223380c076c2ffac4ecfdda7e14b37690.png[/img]
This update brings a significantly improved spawning of enemies as well as some minor bug fixes. You can look forward more dynamic enemy movement with rapid acceleration - they will close on you faster than you blink!
